## Decision Log

1.  Used libcurl dowloader to prevent corruption issues that occurred when using the native dowloader
2.  Unzipped the shapefile using the internal decompression instead of an external tool
3.  Chose the Alaska Albers CRS projection as it is widely used and balances preserving area for spatial mapping and spatial analysis.
4.  Focused on regional data as opposed to management area as this was a more immediately understandable way of presenting the map so that it would be clear to others.
